purpose: Single authored source for the Routine Finder's product attribute model. Generated outward into js/routine-model.js by scripts/generate-routine-model.js. Never hand-edit the generated file.

sources.products-knowledge: 85_assets/kotiva/masters/product-deliverables-2026-06/Products/Products Knowledge.docx — the ONLY document in the client corpus containing directions for use (all 25 'Recommended Use' blocks).
sources.company-profile: Kotiva Company Profile.pdf (36pp, 2026-08-03) — product range grouping (p14), concern taxonomy (p13), age segmentation (p12), per-product overviews.
sources.flyers-brochures: 25 Flyer.docx + 25 Medical brochure data.docx — ingredient lists and mechanism-of-action copy. Contain NO directions for use.

provenance.client-stated: Verbatim assertion in a KOTIVA-supplied document. Quoted in the evidence field.
provenance.client-implied: Unambiguous from client prose, product name, or the client's own range grouping — but not a direct statement.
provenance.dem-inferred: DEM editorial judgement. REQUIRES KOTIVA RATIFICATION before it is presented as KOTIVA's own logic.

ratificationRequired: The canonical step order (only one client statement supports it — product 5's absorption line).
The acid-conflict rule: no client document addresses combining products 20 and 21.
Any safety exclusion. The client corpus contains ZERO pregnancy, contraindication, patch-test or interaction statements.

notBuilt.pregnancy-gate: Question and silent-exclusion mechanism are designed but NOT shipped. Activating it requires kotiva-principal to supply (a) the exclusion list and (b) the disclaimer wording. DEM may not author either.
notBuilt.freeFrom: Empty on all 25 products. Populating it from client documents is a claims-class correction requiring the evidence-package treatment.
notBuilt.frequency-defaults: 6 products state no frequency (4, 13, 14, 18, 19, 24). The engine omits the frequency line rather than inventing one.

catalogueGaps.eye: No eye product exists in the 25-SKU range. The 'Eye Area' concern has been removed from the quiz rather than answered with nothing.
catalogueGaps.facial-anti-ageing: No dedicated facial anti-ageing product. Ageing support routes to product 17 on the strength of the client's own Retinyl Palmitate statement ('Supports skin renewal and improves texture and fine lines').
catalogueGaps.plain-facial-moisturizer: The only facial moisturizers are a post-procedure barrier cream (15) and two whitening creams (16, 17). There is no neutral daily facial moisturizer.

stepOrder.evidence: Only one client statement supports layering: product 5 — 'preparing the skin for better absorption of subsequent skincare products' / 'Prepares the skin for improved absorption of serums and creams'. The remainder is standard cosmetic sequencing (thin to thick, protect last) supplied by DEM.

concerns.evidence: Company Profile p13: 'Our portfolio includes solutions for acne-prone skin, hydration, skin barrier repair, pigmentation, sensitive skin, anti-aging, and daily skin maintenance.' Extended with oil/pores, scars, sun protection and hair loss, each of which has a dedicated product in the client's own range grouping (p14).

skinTypes.evidence: Derived from per-product suitability prose in Products Knowledge and the Company Profile ('for oily, combination and acne-prone skin', 'especially dry and dehydrated skin', 'for sensitive and easily irritated skin'). Sensitivity is deliberately NOT a skin type — it is an independent axis, matching the client's own prose which pairs sensitivity WITH other types ('suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin').

conflictRules.rule: Two products sharing any acid active are never placed in the same routine.
conflictRules.evidence: No client document addresses combining products 20 (salicylic 2% + mandelic 0.5% + azelaic) and 21 (salicylic 1% + mandelic 1% + azelaic 1%), although both target the same oily/acne user. The current live engine stacks them in the oily evening routine. DEM applies the exclusion as a precaution; it is not a client instruction.

conflictRules.rule: When a user reports sensitivity, product 21's frequency drops to the client's own reduced protocol.
conflictRules.evidence: Product 21 directions: 'If it occurs, use product 2-3 times a week.'

conflictRules.evidence: Safety/appropriateness precaution by DEM. The catalogue's 'Sensitive Area' value is one string-prefix from 'Sensitive Skin'.
